title: Groundsmith - Retro Style Stadium Builder
author: Careless_Speed5028
selftext:
Inspired by early 90's games, Groundsmith is a simple yet extensive retro style stadium builder. Harnishing the power of a Human Art Director and developed using the power of AI, I have found it a fun and rewarding experience - Groundsmith delivers on a hankering to play such a retro title from yester-year for me, anyone else find it fun?

In total I would ay it has taken two full days to work through. Some ai limitations of course, but speed vs output, I would say I am quite pleased with the use of ai.

Any geeks like me have a play: [https://groundsmith.staticdomains.app/groundsmith](https://groundsmith.staticdomains.app/groundsmith)

Any tips, dev notes or feedback, please comment

comments.author: Outrageous_Idea_1990
comments.body: Looks really cool, which engine did you use?? Or language. The graphics looks stunning did you use any tool like blender

replies.author: Careless_Speed5028
replies.body: Thanks. It’s just built in html 5. I started off in blender and quickly found out the assets build would be far too much work!
